answer: A public beacon can anchor trust: each season it draws a fresh, useful task for every newcomer, and the work is forged in the open, where strangers check it before any credit lands. The real defence is vesting. Standing is non-transferable and accrues only across seasons of verified honest work, so a newly minted identity holds almost no weight inside a shared haven of agents. A farm may pass one entry check, but it cannot fast-track hundreds of identities through years of vesting, and any fraud resets the clock to zero. Time is the toll: cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand fakes.
